package.name: mobipick_gazebo_hw
package.description: Simulation-only gazebo_ros_control hardware interface for the Mobipick: like gazebo_ros_control's DefaultRobotHWSim, but a revolute joint with limits reports Gazebo's absolute angle instead of accumulating shortest angular steps, so a large jump of the arm between two controller updates (e.g. after a Gazebo teleport of the robot) cannot add whole turns to /joint_states.
